event_summary.short: A St. Croix Tribal Police sergeant conducting a welfare check on a parked vehicle on the shoulder in Webster, Wisconsin, in September 2024, led to a brief vehicle pursuit, a prolonged struggle to remove the 29-year-old female driver from her car, use of a taser, and her arrest on multiple charges including battery of an officer and drug possession.
